name: SeungJu Cha
intro: I am a Ph.D. student in Artificial Intelligence at Hanyang University, advised by Prof. Dong-Jin Kim. My research interests include diffusion and flow models, efficient generation, and physics-aware long-horizon video generation.

news.headline: Which Tokens to Merge? at NeurIPS 2026

news.headline: Seeing Before Synthesizing at EMNLP 2026
news.detail: Work on VLM-guided transition event discovery for dense video captioning.
